title: Zoje A8000-D4-G/02
subtitle: Single-Needle Lockstitch Machine with Direct-Drive Servo and Large-Hook (7 mm stitch)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Zoje A8000 series is a single-needle lockstitch machine with a built-in direct-drive AC servo motor. The -D4-G/02 suffix indicates the D4 control set with the large-hook G variant — capable of stitch lengths up to 7 mm and using a 26 mm large hook for heavy thread work and long stitch applications. Designed for medium and heavy materials.
applications: General straight-stitch seaming on medium and heavy materials
Heavy thread and leather assembly (with large hook variant)
Production lines requiring automatic thread trimmer, reverse feeding, programmable bartacks, foot lifter, needle positioning
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (medium and heavy materials), upholstery, leather goods

overviewDescription: Made by Zoje (Zhejiang, China). The A8000 family replaces the older ZJ8000 series with a direct-drive motor design. Variants: A8000-D4 (standard, 5 mm stitch, regular hook), A8000-D4-HG (heavy, 7 mm stitch, large 26 mm hook), A8000-D4-TP-02 (full-automatic trimmer set). The `-D4-G/02` suffix here is a Zoje ordering code combining the D4 control, G large-hook, and 02 sub-variant.
